# Where the Mitten Meets the Mission


September 23, 2026


by Kate Nadolski


##


## There’s a reason Michiganders call it the Mitten.


Look at a map of the state and you’ll see it immediately: a hand-shaped peninsula stretching north, surrounded by some of the largest freshwater lakes in the world. From Detroit to the Upper Peninsula (UP), Michigan is a state defined by its distinct communities, expansive geography, and strong sense of identity.


It’s also a state that plays a special part in the Tyler Technologies story.


While Tyler Technologies’ corporate headquarters is located in Plano, Texas, Tyler’s Public Safety Division is headquartered right here in **Troy, Michigan** . The Troy office is home to the team developing and supporting technology for all public safety agencies spanning law enforcement, fire, EMS, and more.


When we talk about Tyler Public Safety’s presence in Michigan, we’re not talking about a footprint that starts and ends at the door of our office building.


**Tyler is all around the Mitten — and increasingly, all the way up.**


From long-standing partnerships that span four decades to major statewide and regional deployments, Tyler’s public safety community in Michigan continues to grow.


Today, agencies across the state are using Tyler’s innovative solutions to connect people, information, and operations when every second matters.


With exciting new partnerships extending into the Upper Peninsula and beyond, that footprint is reaching farther than ever.


## More Than 35% of Michigan’s Counties & Growing


Following a[recent announcement](https://investors.tylertech.com/news/news-details/2026/Michigans-Upper-Peninsula-911-Authority-Selects-Tyler-Technologies-Enterprise-CAD-and-Enterprise-Mobile-Solutions/default.aspx) from Michigan’s Upper Peninsula 911 Authority and the North CAD Group, Tyler’s Enterprise CAD footprint will extend to more than 35% of Michigan’s 83 counties. **That means Tyler Technologies will play a role in emergency communications across more than a third of the entire state** .


In other words, **more than one out of every three Michigan counties will be part of Tyler’s Enterprise CAD footprint** .


That’s a pretty significant piece of the Mitten.


This growing client base means potential for greater interoperability and information sharing across jurisdictions, helping agencies work together more seamlessly, particularly when an incident crosses county lines.


## Michigan State Police Partners With Tyler


When an organization as large and far-reaching as the Michigan State Police chooses Tyler, it’s a milestone worth celebrating.


Michigan State Police selected Tyler’s[Enterprise CAD](https://www.tylertech.com/solutions/courts-public-safety/public-safety/computer-aided-dispatch) and[Enterprise Mobile](https://www.tylertech.com/solutions/courts-public-safety/public-safety/mobile-operations) solutions, significantly expanding Tyler’s presence across the state and creating exciting opportunities for greater connectivity among public safety agencies.


For Tyler’s Michigan team, the partnership is also a testament to something that has always mattered deeply in public safety: **relationships** .


Our team knows that partnerships don’t happen in a vacuum. The work Tyler has done alongside agencies throughout Michigan has helped build the relationships, trust, and confidence that ultimately opened the door for Michigan State Police to join the Tyler family.


With Michigan State Police joining Tyler’s ecosystem, agencies have an opportunity to communicate and share information more seamlessly across jurisdictions. That kind of connectivity can be especially valuable in a state as geographically diverse as Michigan, where public safety agencies may need to coordinate across county, regional, and agency boundaries because as we all know, criminals don’t always stay in one place and disaster can strike anytime, anywhere.


## The Upper Peninsula Joins Tyler — ‘Yooper’ Style


If you thought Tyler’s Michigan footprint stopped somewhere around the Mackinac Bridge, think again. We’re headed about as north as you can go without leaving the country.


In 2026, the Michigan Upper Peninsula 911 Authority, on behalf of the North CAD Group, selected Tyler’s Enterprise CAD and Enterprise Mobile solutions for a regional deployment spanning 12 counties — eight counties in the Upper Peninsula and four counties in the northern Lower Peninsula.


The deployment includes Chippewa, Luce, Mackinac, Alger, Delta, Menominee, Dickinson, and Iron counties in the UP, along with Roscommon, Charlevoix, Cheboygan, and Emmet counties in the northern Lower Peninsula.


For Michigan, this is a big deal, and here’s why:


The regional deployment is designed to support CAD-to-CAD connectivity across Michigan’s Upper and Lower Peninsulas, with compatibility for Michigan State Police integration. The goal is to help create a more connected emergency communications environment where agencies can share information, strengthen situational awareness, and coordinate more effectively when incidents span jurisdictions.


To put it simply, Tyler Public Safety is thrilled to be extending our reach into **‘Yooper territory.’**


**And really, what could beat seamless technology and homemade pasties?**


## Midland County Goes Live in Just Nine Months


Technology transformation takes time. But sometimes, the mission can’t wait.


That was the reality for Midland County Central Dispatch Authority, which needed to replace its previous CAD system after its vendor announced the end of support.


[Midland County selected Tyler’s Enterprise CAD and Mobile solutions](https://investors.tylertech.com/news/news-details/2026/Midland-County-Michigan-Completes-Implementation-of-Tyler-Technologies-Public-Safety-Solutions/default.aspx) and the implementation was completed on an accelerated nine-month timeline, with cloud-hosted solutions going live in April of 2025.


**That timeline is notable on its own. But what makes the Midland County story even more impressive is what the system supports today.**


Tyler’s solutions aid the dispatch authority in supporting public safety operations for five local, county, and state law enforcement agencies, 12 fire service departments, and one private EMS provider, collectively managing more than 75,000 calls for service each year.


That’s a lot of activity and a lot of information that needs to move quickly and accurately.


The accelerated implementation demonstrates what’s possible when an agency, its implementation team, and technology provider work together with a clear goal: maintain continuity of operations while making the transition to a modern, cloud-hosted public safety environment.


For Midland County, going live wasn’t simply about replacing an aging system. **It was about creating a foundation that can support the people answering the calls, dispatching resources, and responding in the field every day** .


## Four Decades of Partnership: A Michigan Tradition


New partnerships are exciting. However, **some of the most meaningful milestones come from the relationships that have stood the test of time** .


At Tyler’s most recent[Connect conference](https://www.tylertech.com/connect) , Grand Traverse County Sheriff and the Allegan County Sheriff’s Office were recognized for reaching an extraordinary milestone: 40 years with Tyler Public Safety.


**That’s FOUR DECADES!**


That means these agencies have been part of the Tyler Public Safety story for generations: through changing technologies and mandates, evolving public safety needs, and countless shifts in how communities communicate and respond to emergencies.


**Their longevity speaks to something we value enormously at Tyler: clients aren’t just customers. They’re partners.**


Public safety technology has changed dramatically over the past 40 years. What hasn’t changed is the importance of having a trusted technology partner that understands the mission and is willing to evolve alongside the agencies it serves.


Grand Traverse County and Allegan County are remarkable examples of that kind of partnership, and we’re proud to celebrate this milestone with them.


## Where the Mitten Meets the Mission


Michigan has given Tyler Public Safety plenty to celebrate.


There are the milestones: more counties, more agencies, new partnerships, and a growing regional presence that now stretches from the Lower Peninsula to the far reaches of the UP. There are also the relationships behind those milestones: some brand new, and others that have been growing for more than 40 years.


While Michigan represents an important part of Tyler Public Safety’s work, **it’s also a reflection of something much bigger** . Wherever public safety professionals are working to keep their communities safe, they need technology that can keep pace with the job. They need systems that work together, information that moves when it needs to, and a partner that understands what’s at stake.


That’s the work Tyler Public Safety is committed to — in Michigan, across the United States, and beyond.


And within the Mitten, that work is reaching far and wide.


As you’ve read, it starts in Troy, home to Tyler Public Safety’s headquarters. It stretches to Midland, where a new generation of public safety technology is already at work. It reaches across the Lower Peninsula, supporting agencies and communities through Michigan State Police operations from the Metro area to the Thumb, across West Michigan and into the northern reaches of the state.


And then there’s the Mighty Mac.


Cross the bridge, and the journey continues all the way into the Upper Peninsula, where our growing presence now spans 12 counties and opens new possibilities for regional connectivity across the UP and beyond.


**From the Mitten to the UP, we’re proud to be part of something bigger: helping public safety agencies stay connected, informed, and ready to respond when their communities need them most.**
